seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x1, pixels,tags x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player: A1-4 turn cap + move 4 unless wall/box/chaser/bounds; box faced iff at player+cap dir (resolves the A3 [player,wall] hypothesis: facing, not click position).
A5 toggles faced<->grabbed; grabbed box moves rigidly with player; boxes ignore walls (wall dither column masked by objects above).
Chaser every step: release seated carried box; else drag carried box (at chaser-4) to nearest empty slot; else go to right side of nearest free box and grab next step; x-first, y if blocked.
Box tags/border colour by state (idle4 carried5 faced3 grabbed0) + seated; names box_i by (y,x); slots empty/filled.
Unconfirmed: pulling a grabbed box backward, chaser detour when both axes blocked, cap_down sprite, slot choice tie-breaks. Stateless.
